events.title: ALPHABET SOUP
events.description: The Presynct presents ALPHABET SOUP 🌈🥫 A big, bold, gloriously queer night of cabaret, comedy, games, dancing and all your favourite 80s queer anthems! events.title: EMOWAVE at The Presynct
events.description: EMOWAVE AT THE PRESYNCT The eyeliner is back. The anthems never left. Get ready for a full night of emo and pop punk nostalgia as EMOWAVE at The Presynct takes over Nambour for one massive celebration of the songs that defined a generation. Headlining the night are Forever On High, one of the Gold Coast's rising alternative acts, bringing their explosive live show and soaring anthems to The Presynct. They'll be joined by Dirty Hearts and No Clue, before we hand things over to the DJ to keep the energy going until midnight. Expect wall-to-wall emo, pop punk and alternative classics from artists including: My Chemical Romance • Paramore • Fall Out Boy • Bring Me The Horizon • A Day To Remember • Blink-182 • Linkin Park • Sleeping With Sirens • Sum 41 • All Time Low • Green Day • Panic! At The Disco • Good Charlotte • Bullet For My Valentine • Escape The Fate • The Amity Affliction • Falling In Reverse • Bad Omens and many more. Whether you grew up blasting these bands on your iPod or you've only just discovered them, this is your chance to sing every word, relive the glory days, and lose yourself in a night of unforgettable music. Live Music Forever On High Dirty Hearts No Clue After the Bands Our DJ will keep the party alive with the biggest emo and pop punk anthems right through until midnight. Dust off the band tees, lace up the Converse, gather your crew and prepare for a night of heartbreak, nostalgia and loud singalongs. This is The Presynct Goes Emo. Emo never died - it just found a new home. 📅 Saturday 26th September ⏰ Doors 6:00pm (Happy Hour) | Event Doors from 7:00pm 🎟 General $15+BF | Door $20 🔞 18+ Event 🩴 NO Thongs Permitted 🚱 NO Outside Drink bottles

events.title: Michael St George
events.description: MICHAEL ST GEORGE + ROOTS N BLOOM Jamaican roots. Reggae. Dub. Spoken word. Conscious music. The Presynct welcomes internationally acclaimed Jamaican-born Michael St George for a special night of roots reggae, dub poetry, rhythm and powerful storytelling. Born in Portland, Jamaica and raised in Kingston, Michael St George is a poet, singer, songwriter and renowned dub performance artist whose music brings together roots reggae, spoken word, world rhythms and jazz, carrying messages of social justice, connection, universal love and positive change. With a career spanning decades and continents, Michael has performed and collaborated with artists across Jamaica, Canada and Australia, including OKA, Dennis Bovell, Earl “Chinna” Smith and Ollie McGill of The Cat Empire. In Australia, he has toured with OKA, collaborated on their The Sunset Sessions, performed at the Sydney Opera House and was the closing act at GARMA 2017. Joining Michael are Sunshine Coast special guests ROOTS N BLOOM - a collective of women brought together through music, culture and community. Their beautiful vocal harmonies, global influences and heartfelt storytelling create music centred around connection, joy and belonging. Together, Michael St George and Roots N Bloom make this a night built around reggae, roots, soul and community - uplifting live music with something to say. Come early, grab a drink and settle in for a night of conscious music and positive vibes. 📅 Saturday 3rd October ⏰ Doors 6:00pm (Happy Hour) | Event Doors from 7:00pm 🎟 General $35+BF | Door $40 🔞 18+ Event 🩴 NO Thongs Permitted 🚱 NO Outside Drink bottles
